# cpanel_boxtrapper_settings (Data Source)

Looks up BoxTrapper status and configuration for an existing cPanel mail account. The account can be a complete mailbox address or the cPanel system username.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cpanel_boxtrapper_settings" "support" {
  account = "support@example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account` (String) The existing mailbox address or cPanel system username.

### Read-Only

- `enable_auto_whitelist` (Boolean) Whether BoxTrapper automatically allowlists addresses that the account contacts.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether BoxTrapper is enabled for the account.
- `from_addresses` (String) The comma-separated sender addresses BoxTrapper associates with the account.
- `from_name` (String) The optional sender name reported by cPanel. This is null when no name is configured.
- `queue_days` (Number) The number of days BoxTrapper retains logs and queued messages.
- `spam_score` (Number) The SpamAssassin score at which BoxTrapper bypasses challenge verification.
- `whitelist_by_association` (Boolean) Whether BoxTrapper allowlists recipients associated with an allowlisted sender.
